text:
I can't say whether the property is legally compliant. The evidence doesn't make any regulatory or compliance finding, including on EUDR or deforestation-free status.

What it does show for ASSET-B (2,843.1 ha), as of 2026-11-12:
- No tree-cover loss event of 0.5 ha or more was detected between 2021-01-01 and 2025-12-31. Valid observations covered the whole asset.
- Only 0.4 ha of loss in small patches was seen in 2021. It falls below the 0.5 ha event threshold, so it isn't counted.
- JRC data shows 0 ha of forest in 2020. Hansen shows 23 ha of tree cover in 2000.
- Earlier loss events before the 2020 baseline were 0.8 ha (2008), 25.5 ha (2015), 4.8 ha (2017) and 67.7 ha (2020). These fall outside the evaluated period.

Limits: changes smaller than 0.5 ha, at edges, or narrower than the 30 m pixels may be missed. The evidence also says nothing about periods outside 2021–2025. A compliance conclusion would need legal review and other information.
